summary: R4 cannot safely compose the required outer shared resource lock with R2 dispatch_once: R2 unconditionally acquires the identical resource lock and refuses while R4 owns it. R2 has no lock-token reuse or already-owned dispatch API. Releasing the outer lock to call dispatch_once violates the required cycle-wide exclusivity. Per instruction, R1-R3 were not edited; no R4 implementation was attempted.
